test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Pointing to a woman, Param(a man) said, "She is the mother-in-law of the mother-in-law of the daughter-in-law of my father." How is Param related to the woman?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab14d171ebe3bb1528e3a41bba0e53fda2a0f37aed6eb57c0a665394ab6ce6d.png] 

The mother-in-law of the daughter-in-law of my father is my mother.

Mother-in-law of my mother is my paternal grandmother.

Therefore, Param is grandson of the woman.

Hence, '**Grandson**' is the correct answer.
